arguments.sql:
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.orders) AS orders,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.orders WHERE delivery IS NULL) AS orders_without_delivery,
    (SELECT MIN(ordered) FROM main.orders) AS first_order_date,
    (SELECT MAX(purchased) FROM main.purchases) AS last_purchase_date,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.orderlines WHERE qty <= 0) AS nonpositive_order_lines,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.inventory WHERE qty <= 0) AS nonpositive_inventory_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
        SELECT order_id, product_id
        FROM main.orderlines
        GROUP BY order_id, product_id
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    )) AS repeated_order_products,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.products) AS products,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM main.orderlines) AS ordered_products,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.orderlines AS ol
     LEFT JOIN main.orders AS o ON o.id = ol.order_id
     WHERE o.id IS NULL) AS unmatched_order_lines,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.inventory AS i
     LEFT JOIN main.purchases AS p ON p.id = i.purchase_id
     WHERE p.id IS NULL OR p.product_id <> i.product_id) AS unmatched_inventory_rows

)

FROM main.products AS p
LEFT JOIN ordered AS o ON o.product_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN stocked AS i ON i.product_id = p.id
ORDER BY p.name

arguments.sql:
WITH order_ranges AS (
    SELECT
        ol.id AS order_line_id,
        ol.product_id,
        ol.qty AS required_qty,
        SUM(ol.qty) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ol.product_id
            ORDER BY o.ordered, o.id, ol.id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS order_end
    FROM main.orderlines AS ol
    JOIN main.orders AS o ON o.id = ol.order_id
),
inventory_ranges AS (
    SELECT
        i.product_id,
        i.qty AS available_qty,
        SUM(i.qty) OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.product_id
            ORDER BY pu.purchased, i.qty, i.location_id, i.id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS inventory_end
    FROM main.inventory AS i
    JOIN main.purchases AS pu ON pu.id = i.purchase_id
),
order_picks AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_line_id,
        o.product_id,
        o.required_qty,
        COALESCE(
            SUM(
                MIN(o.order_end, i.inventory_end)
                - MAX(o.order_end - o.required_qty, i.inventory_end - i.available_qty)
            ),
            0
        ) AS picked_qty
    FROM order_ranges AS o
    LEFT JOIN inventory_ranges AS i
        ON i.product_id = o.product_id
        AND i.inventory_end > o.order_end - o.required_qty
        AND o.order_end > i.inventory_end - i.available_qty
    GROUP BY o.order_line_id, o.product_id, o.required_qty
)
SELECT
    p.name AS product_name,
    AVG(100.0 * op.picked_qty / NULLIF(op.required_qty, 0)) AS avg_pick_percentage
FROM order_picks AS op
JOIN main.products AS p ON p.id = op.product_id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY p.name
LIMIT -1
